utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Gus is bringing his tools. That should help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive is on Saturday. Sam's helping me with the fence too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, Sam is handy. I'll be there Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools. What's first to fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Leo! I have the list of repair requests; let's start with the Henderson's leaky faucet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, let's head to the Hendersons.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive is this Saturday. Gus is bringing tools to borrow, and I think Quinn mentioned something about a rake for Dane.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Saturday works for me. I'll make sure to bring some snacks for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Awesome, snacks sound great. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, just making sure my tool sign-out sheet is ready for Saturday's repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I've got the toolbox ready with Noah's duct tape, screws, and hammer. Just add your sign-out sheet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll bring the sign-out sheet and make sure everyone checks out their tools properly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday sounds good. Noah and Gus are all set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I think the drive is on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Mara, I'm sure it's Saturday. Noah and Gus confirmed for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? Gus and Noah are bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Actually, I thought it was Sunday? I hope we have everything organized, especially with the sign-out sheet Gus is handling.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, it's definitely Saturday—I hope that doesn't throw off your plans! And I think Gus is on top of the sign-out sheet, he's pretty organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, did you hear? Leo's bringing his tool kit to the repair drive—that'll be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's good, but Noah is also bringing duct tape, screws, and a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Noah too! We're getting quite the team together. Hope you can join us as well!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Hana. Did you say something about the repair drive? I think I zoned out for a second.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I was just saying we should check with Gus about the tools and the sign-out sheet before we start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right—Gus. Yeah, let's go find him.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive is on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there to help out. I also need to help Oren with his fence sometime.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let me know if you need a hand with the fence.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So the repair drive is this Saturday, right? Gus will bring the tools, Sam's helping out, and Ira's attending.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Actually, Mara's the one bringing the tools, not Gus. But yeah, I'll be there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Mara brings the tools? Got it, I'll remember that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, any news on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Vik's got things moving, and Gus has his toolbox ready—he'll have tools sorted by the time I swing by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great to hear. Sounds like everything's coming together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've been helping Faye with the repair drive schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get the supplies from Noah sorted into the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I managed to fit everything in, though it was a tight squeeze.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, I'll drop by after lunch today. Is there anything you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you bring any spare tools you have? I just want to make sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I'll round up some extra tools and bring them over after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, I heard the repair drive is this Saturday. Are you planning to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, I think it's actually Sunday, not Saturday. Gus is handling the tools and sign-out sheet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm pretty sure it's Saturday, Pia. Gus confirmed it with me last week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, our repair drive is this Saturday—I'll be there to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you Saturday. Don't forget Gus has tools to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the reminder, I'll check with Gus.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? Faye mentioned I should help with the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it's still set for Saturday. Did Faye say which part of the schedule she wanted you to help with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: She mentioned sorting out the volunteer shifts for the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, did you hear about the repair drive? Leo's bringing his tool kit—should be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds familiar... Is it this Saturday? Sam's been helping me with my fence, maybe he can join too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it's this Saturday! Sam would be a great addition—why don't you ask him to come along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Did you know Noah brought duct tape, screws, and a hammer for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great! Noah's always so prepared. Is the repair drive happening after school tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure about the exact time, but I think it's after school. Let me check with the others.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, just wanted to double-check the repair drive is still on for Saturday? I might be a bit late, but I'm coming.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Oh, right, the repair drive. Yeah, I think so. What time again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think it's at 10 AM, right? I'll be there a bit after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope Gus's tools are enough for what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Gus always brings a good set. And Sam will be there to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm glad Sam will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got my tools ready for Saturday's repair drive. I even made a sign-out sheet so we can keep track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like you've got it organized, Gus. I'll spread the word when I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira. If you see Tess, remind her I can look at that porch chair leg, too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got my tools. Noah dropped off duct tape, screws, and a hammer. What's next?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, tools are set. Don't forget, Rosa has the list of households—we'll meet at the community center on Sunday to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, Sunday at the community center. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, so the repair drive is set for Saturday. Glad Noah and Gus are contributing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and I heard Uli's garden gate is sticking—maybe someone can bring some oil or sandpaper.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll add that to the list. We'll take care of it on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Mina, I've got the sign-up sheet ready and the list of households needing repairs. Are you still able to help coordinate volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can still coordinate. Did Noah drop off the duct tape and screws?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm not sure about that—Gus is handling the tools and sign-out sheet. Want me to check with him?
